existing_offline_evaluation_audit.leakage_risk_explanation: Critical Finding: research_xgboost_4class_pipeline.joblib was fitted on X_full (all 7,493 rows across 318 records), which explicitly included mitdb_100, vfdb_425, mitdb_200, and vfdb_424. Consequently, evaluating this specific joblib artifact offline on these four records measures re-substitution / in-sample behavior rather than generalization to unseen patients. While fold-level cross-validation was strictly grouped, zero unseen records have been evaluated offline with the serialized model.

BRADYCARDIA.primary_training_source: mitdb_232 provided 55.0% of all bradycardia windows (121/220)
BRADYCARDIA.evaluation_deficiency: Zero records with official reference-annotated (SBR (Sinus Bradycardia) have been evaluated offline. vfdb_425 was evaluated, but its WFDB annotation is (N (sinus origin); the 12 BRADYCARDIA predictions were rate-based post-hoc discoveries. mitdb_232 (the source of 55% of all training bradycardia) was never evaluated offline across its full 30-minute recording.

VENTRICULAR.primary_training_source: vfdb provided 82.3% (1,512/1,838) of all training ventricular windows
VENTRICULAR.evaluation_deficiency: Only 35 unambiguous 5-second ventricular windows across only 2 records (vfdb_424 and vfdb_425) have been evaluated offline. Both records were in the training set. Model 2 has NEVER been evaluated on sustained ventricular tachycardia or fibrillation from an independent, unseen database like CUDB.

TACHY.primary_training_source: c2015 provided 89.2% (323/362) of training tachycardia windows
TACHY.evaluation_deficiency: Zero true reference-annotated (SVTA or (ST windows have been evaluated offline. The 23 TACHY predictions in vfdb_424/mitdb_200 were misclassifications of ventricular flutter, noise, or borderlines. Model 2's offline performance on genuine supraventricular tachycardia is completely unvalidated.

NSR.evaluation_deficiency: 1,064 unambiguous NSR windows have been evaluated, but 100% came from records present in the training set. Independent negative control testing on clean, unseen normal sinus rhythm subjects is missing.
